name: v1.3.0
body:
## Default Excluded Tags:
You can now flag tags as "Excluded by Default". Tags that are excluded by default are automatically excluded when launching the app and when clearing the tag selection. Useful if you have files which you'd like to track in Impart that you don't necessarily want to browse every time you open the app!

## Other Stuff

- When editing the tags on a file, tags are now ordered by their order in the side bar (instead of whatever order they were originally assigned in)
  - Alternatively, the tags may be ordered alphabetically, configurable via the new "Tagging" options screen
- Added a new "Displayed Files" filter in the search bar filters  which lets you choose which type of files to display (image files only, non-image files only, etc)
- Accidentally added the wrong directory to Impart? You can now halt file indexing via the little drop down menu  on the indexing panel!
- You can now detach a source file from an image file (from the right click menu on the image)
- When a non-image file with tags gets associated with an image file, that image file now inherits those tags (can be disabled in the Tagging options)
- You can now disable showing the patch notes on update
  - You can now also view the patch notes manually from the "Updates" options screen
- Finally fixed a bug where tag selection would be ignored while the app was starting up
- The app now has logs! They can be found at [USER]/AppData/Roaming/impart/logs/main.log on Windows and [USER]/.config/impart/logs/main.log on Linux
- Added some additional empty results images!
- Fixed an error being thrown when trying to delete a tag category that contains tags that are attached to files
- Fixed an edge case where dragging a tag while bulk tagging files would break the whole interface
- Uninstalling Impart now also properly clears out the app data on Windows
- Updated electron, typescript and a few other small packages

name: v1.2.0
body:
## Linux Support!
To celebrate its one year anniversary, Impart has been ported to Linux! By virtue of being built in electron, the Linux version of Impart is feature complete, and will receive updates alongside the windows version (Thanks to @the-furry-hubofeverything)

## Private Tags
Want to show someone something in Impart, but afraid you might expose your most deep and personal inner machinations? Rejoice! You can now flag tags as "Private", which can be toggled on and off such that all private tags (and any art tagged with those tags) are hidden.

## Other Stuff
- Added in-app patch notes (which is how you're seeing this right now!)
- Added the ability to disable auto-updating (in the settings under "Updates")
- Added a Refresh button which re-indexes all directories and loads any changed files
- Added several additional "No Items Found" images (Thanks to @Zelevai for ideas!)
- Updated About page
- Updated almost every single package internally; Electron, React, Vite, MUI, you name it!
- Fixed a bug where updating a directory's recursiveness didn't actually do anything
- Fixed reported file changes when updating directory settings ("This will add X files and remove X files") being slightly off
- Fixed the app becoming unresponsive when using the "Create Stack" button in the selection indicator (the little popup on the lower left corner of the screen)
- Fixed not being able to add a folder if its name "contained" another folder that was already indexed and is recursive (/my folder vs /my folder but cooler)
- The whole app now properly uses the correct fonts. IDK if there were any spots that used the wrong font, but if there were, they're gone now

name: v1.0.0-rc.0
body:
## APP RESET
The way data is stored in the app has been updated to better suit long term maintenance, but it's not compatible with data from the beta, so installing this update will reset the app. This should be the only time this happens

## Features
- Added new fonts and updated app styling
- Improved drag and drop feedback across the app
- A tagging animation plays when tagging an item via drag and drop
- Added "No Items Found" message with randomized art for when the grid is empty
- You can now resize the tag selector
- The window size and position is now persistent
- Added a really basic About page
- Added missing art for directory conflict modal
- Removed beta warning
- Added new filter button to the search
- Minor context menu touchups

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed several bugs with tag searching
- Fixed the selected tags panel showing up "offscreen" at the bottom of the scrollable
- Fixed being able to launch multiple instances of the app (with the second instance acting very buggy)

name: v0.5.0
body:
**NOTE**: This is the final beta update, v1.0.0 is coming up next

## Features
- **Advanced Drag and Drop**
  - Drag and drop now supports multiple selections of files. If you drag a tag onto a selection, it will tag *all* of the selected files
  - You can now re-order tag groups and tags via drag and drop
  - You can now associate images with a source file by dragging the images onto the source file
- **Recursive Directories**: You can now set a directory to be recursive, which will load all files in all subfolders of a given directory
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**
  - Ctrl + A = Select all files
  - Ctrl + D = Deselect all files
  - Ctrl + E = Edit the tags on the current selection
  - Escape = Closes most editors
- Added a new screen to manually associate images with source files
- You can now search for tags
- Added a panel which shows the currently selected tags, along with a clear button to clear the current tag selection
- A confirmation is now shown when editing directories which shows how many files will be added and removed
- Recently modified files are now re-indexed and have their thumbnails regenerated

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed tag selection getting reset after editing any tag or tag group
- Thumbnails are now regenerated if the underlying thumbnail did not exist

name: v0.4.0
body:
## Features 
- **Basic Drag and Drop** - *Note: All Drag and Drop actions are currently only one at a time. Multi-item drag and drop will be implemented soon(ish)*
  - You can now tag items by dragging tags onto them
  - You can now add items to stacks by dragging them onto stacks 
  - You can move items out of stacks by dragging them onto the "Home" breadcrumb (or any of the other breadcrumbs)

- **Stack Updates**
  - You can now rename stacks and update their cover image
  - Stacks can now be nested
  - You can now "explode" stacks (inner files are brought up to the current level rather than deleted)
  - When creating a stack, if every item within the stack has a given tag, the stack will also have that tag
  - Stacks are no longer bound to a directory, they will not be auto-tagged and they will not get randomly deleted if their directory is deleted
- Added an "Open File Location" option to the file context menu
- Deleted (or missing) files are now automatically removed from the app

## Bugfixes
- Fixed stacks being excluded from searches

name: v0.3.0
body:
## Features
- **Inline Tag Editing** - The "Edit Tags" page has been removed in favor of a brand new interface which lets you tag items from directly within the grid
- A "Generating Thumbnails" indicator pops up while the app is generating thumbnails for new items
- The right click menu no longer blocks scrolling or clicking
- Implemented proper error notifications

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed several cases where the grid wasn't refreshing after certain actions:
  - After item tagging
  - After stack creation
  - After the app finishes indexing a new directory
- Fixed edge case in automatic image/source file assocation

name: v0.1.0
body:
# Beta Release
Introducing Impart: A gallery organization tool that lets you tag and search through your art!

![impartDemo](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f0740e5e-53c6-445f-8c1e-e0ab85c239de)

## Features
- **Tagging** - Create tags, apply them to your files and then use them to filter through your files. Organize your art by character, by color palette or completeness, whatever you want!
- **Searching and sorting** - Search through your files pretty much instantly and sort them by name or date
- **Source Association** - Source files are automatically associated with image files (based on file name) and hidden on the grid, so you've got more room to browse your art. You can access source files directly by right clicking image files and selecting "Open Source"
- **Stacks** - Groups of files can be combined into a Stack which shows as an individual item on the grid and can be tagged like any other file.
